name: awakening
description: High-fidelity rendering for 3D worlds: production PBR lighting, a film-grade post stack (sharpen, AO, sun-lit mist, filmic grade), volumetric clouds, realistic wind-blown grass, 2K PBR ground textures, river-eroded mountains, a procedural forest planner with trails, forest-floor cover, a layered rock material, and Awakening Water: shared swell, ripples and wakes, shore foam and wet sand, optional squalls and thunderstorms with rain and lightning.
